text: A lichen is a composite organism in which a fungus provides a protective structure (the thallus) and a photosynthetic partner, an alga or cyanobacterium, provides fixed carbon.
explanation: True. The lichen symbiosis pairs a fungus (usually an ascomycete) whose thallus buffers desiccation, UV, and mechanical stress with a photosynthetic partner that supplies carbon the non-photosynthetic fungus cannot make; many lichens also host basidiomycete yeasts and bacterial communities as additional partners.
